ruleDefinitions.name: Remote PowerShell Session (PS Module)
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects remote PowerShell sessions Note: Unmapped fields: ContextInfo

sequences.query: (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\=\\ ServerRemoteHost\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*wsmprovhost\\\.exe.*")) AND  NOT (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\Modules\\\\Microsoft\\\.PowerShell\\\.Archive\\\\Microsoft\\\.PowerShell\\\.Archive\\\.psm1.*"))
